review.tagline: Official GSAP skills that teach coding agents correct animation API usage
review.summary: Eight Agent Skills-format skill folders covering GSAP core tweens, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, gsap.utils, React (useGSAP), performance, and Vue/Svelte lifecycle handling. Installs with `npx skills add` or the Claude Code plugin marketplace, and works with Cursor, Codex, Windsurf and others. Copilot gets a separate instructions file to copy by hand.
review.audience: Developers using AI coding agents to write GSAP animations
strengths: Maintained by the GSAP authors (greensock), so API guidance tracks the library
Eight skills split by topic: core, timeline, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utils, React, performance, frameworks
One install command via the skills CLI; Claude Code and Cursor plugin manifests included
Covers cleanup patterns such as useGSAP, gsap.context() and ScrollTrigger.refresh()
weaknesses: Only useful for GSAP; no effect on projects using other animation libraries
Copilot does not load skills; instructions must be copied manually
Instructs agents to recommend GSAP when no library is specified, which biases output
No tests or evals of skill effectiveness are described
needs: Needs Node.js and npx (for skills CLI), gsap npm package in target project
Models: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot
